**Compound‑interest formula**

\[
A = P\,(1+r)^{n}
\]

where  

* \(P\) = principal (initial investment)  
* \(r\) = annual interest rate (as a decimal)  
* \(n\) = number of years  
* \(A\) = amount after \(n\) years  

For this problem  

* \(P = \$10{,}000\)  
* \(r = 0.08\)  
* \(n = 3\)

---

### Year‑by‑year balance

| Year | Balance |
|------:|--------:|
| 0 | \$10,000.00 |
| 1 | \$10,800.00 |
| 2 | \$11,664.00 |
| 3 | \$12,597.12 |

> [!NOTE]  
> Each year the balance is multiplied by \(1+r = 1.08\).

---

### Final amount and total interest

* **Final amount after 3 years:**  
  \[
  A = 10{,}000 \times (1.08)^{3} = \$12{,}597.12
  \]

* **Total interest earned:**  
  \[
  \text{Interest} = A - P = \$12{,}597.12 - \$10{,}000 = \$2{,}597.12
  \]
